_comment: Datasheet access-notation synonyms -> canonical access type, per vendor. The validator treats every listed synonym as equivalent to its canonical key when checking an `access` invariant, so it stops rejecting a correct `read-write` just because the datasheet writes it as e.g. `rc_w0`. TO ADD A VENDOR: copy a block, set the key to the vendor slug (lowercase, matches Manufacturer name), and list that vendor's notation codes under the three canonical access types. Matching is case-insensitive and exact-token (so `r` does not match `rc_w0`). Synonyms not found here fall back to the `default` block.
